messages:
anna-sales: FinCorp POC blocked — Okta SSO failing and SCIM user creates 409 due to email casing. Need eng + devex to triage.
fincorp-sre: SAMLResponse parse error: 'invalid character '\u0000' in prolog' when our gateway proxies the response. Metadata URL: https://fin-corp.okta.com/app/exk1b2y3/meta/sso/saml/metadata
sam-eng: Likely null bytes injected by their proxy or double-encoding. Can you capture the base64 SAMLResponse? Also check if Okta is sending Response vs Assertion.
fincorp-sre: Captured decoded SAML blob — contains � sequences right after the XML prolog. Proxy team says they enable gzip and do some header munging.
maria-devex: SCIM: Okta sometimes preserves original case which causes duplicates. We can add per-tenant email normalization or accept case-insensitive compare. Recommend toggling tenant flag 'normalizeEmails'.
sam-eng: I'll push a small parser tolerance behind a feature flag (saml.lenient_decode) to strip harmless nulls and accept padded base64. Will canary it.
security-bot: Any parser tolerance must be feature-flagged, logged, and have a rollback plan. Create a ticket with the sample payload.
deploy-bot: canary deploy of saml parser flag succeeded on eng-runtime-canary-2. Monitor for 5m.
fincorp-sre: Toggled normalizeEmails, retried SCIM -> 201 Created. SAML flows work with lenient flag on.
eli-cs: Scheduling a 30m call with FinCorp SRE + proxy team for tomorrow 11am PT to root-cause and get Dedicated POC dates.
anna-sales: Thanks team — marking POC unblocked. Next: postmortem notes and security review before flag is removed.
